title: Pre-Migration: Introduce SearchInterface Abstraction
description: Decouple memory layer from search layer by introducing SearchInterface abstraction. This resolves ARCH-003 tight coupling issue where memory layer directly depends on search implementation. Must be completed before TypeScript migration to enable independent layer migration.

criteria: SearchInterface defines 3 core methods: search(), index(), delete()
Memory layer imports SearchInterface instead of concrete search implementation
74 existing pytest tests pass after refactoring
No functional changes - behavior remains identical
